channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: Light travels faster than sound.
item.description:
Light travels faster than sound.
That's why some people appear bright until you hear them speak.

item.title: What starts with the letter 'F' and ends in 'uck'?
item.description:
What starts with the letter 'F' and ends in 'uck'?
Firetruck.

item.title: My 5 year old nephew came up to me with an outstretched hand holding an acorn. "Uncle, what's this?" he asks.
item.description:
My 5 year old nephew came up to me with an outstretched hand holding an acorn. "Uncle, what's this?" he asks.
"That? That's a tree!" I replied "This is a tree?" he asks with a wrinkled look. "Yeah, in a nutshell!" I said.

item.title: Remember when botox used to be kinda taboo?
item.description:
Remember when botox used to be kinda taboo?
Now nobody even raises an eyebrow.

item.title: My wife just left me.
item.description:
My wife just left me.
She says my life revolves around football and she's sick of it. I'm quite upset. We were together for 7 seasons.

item.title: In honor of St Patrick’s Day
item.description:
In honor of St Patrick’s Day
What do you call an Irishman sitting on the porch? Paddy O’Furniture.

item.title: When my grandfather turned 65 he started walking 5 miles a day..
item.description:
When my grandfather turned 65 he started walking 5 miles a day..
He's 90 now and we have no idea where he is.

item.title: I was reading in the paper today about this dwarf that got pick-pocketed.
item.description:
I was reading in the paper today about this dwarf that got pick-pocketed.
How could anyone stoop so low?

item.title: What do you call two monkeys sharing an Amazon account?
item.description:
What do you call two monkeys sharing an Amazon account?
Prime-mates.

item.title: Did you hear about the guy who swallowed a lamp?
item.description:
Did you hear about the guy who swallowed a lamp?
He just wanted a light snack.
